checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: read-only claim-ref verifier against live log episode headers

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 85 made verdict refs caller-provided but nothing checks them against a real log. A verifier can extract header episode_sha256 values and report verified/unverified/unreferenced refs, closing the provenance gap without changing claims.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_claim_refs builds verified/unverified/unreferenced counts and unknown-episode findings; verify_claim_store loads a snapshot first; multiple logs and multiple headers per log are unioned; a real T3:15/T3:65 ref pair verifies 2/2 while a missing log or fabricated ref is named.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new claims_verify.py only, no claim/store schema change; dependency: telemetry.log read-only; concurrency: none; state: no writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require a ClaimLedger and at least one readable log with an episode header; validate missing/malformed/no-header logs; test verified/unknown/missing-log/no-header/multiple-headers/store/invalid; rerun 379 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: chain/HMAC integrity checks for claim-ref verification

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-86 verifier trusts any parseable header episode digest; a caller-supplied log with a copied digest passes. verify_chain can reject edited/reordered/unchained logs, and an optional hmac_key can verify keyed records, before their episode headers are trusted.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_claim_refs(..., hmac_key=None, verify_logs=True) runs chain verification on every log; a tampered log raises by default while verify_logs=False keeps the membership-only ablation; a keyed log verifies with the correct key and fails with a wrong key; claim-store verification passes the same options.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verifier kwargs only, claim/store schema unchanged; dependency: telemetry.log verify_chain; concurrency: none; state: read-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default to chain verification, validate hmac_key/verify_logs, name the failing findings, test intact/tampered/off/keyed/wrong-key/store/malformed, and rerun 389 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional anchor-journal witness in claim-ref verification

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-87 verifier checks the log hash chain, but a valid truncated prefix or a fully rewritten chain still passes. The existing anchor journal is an external witness with a sequence/head; verify_chain(path, journal_path=...) can compare the log to it.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_claim_refs/verify_claim_store accept journal_paths (one path for one log or a per-log mapping); the journal is verified first and the log head/count must match; a truncated prefix passes chain-only but raises with the journal; missing/tampered journals and unknown mappings are named; read-only.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verifier kwarg only, claim/store schema unchanged; dependency: telemetry.log verify_chain; concurrency: none; state: read-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize and validate journal mappings, require verify_logs=True, default None keeps old behavior, test anchored/truncated/missing/tampered/two-log/store/unknown cases, and rerun 393 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: add header seed and independently verify episode_sha256; opt-in claim-ref integration

impact_assessment.why: The header binds an episode digest computed from the initial state, task, seed, max_steps and policy digest, but it omits the seed. A verifier cannot rebuild the deterministic initial state and recompute the digest, so claim refs trust an unverified episode binding.
impact_assessment.benefits: write_header accepts seed; run_task_logged records it; verify_episode_header rebuilds GridWorld(task,seed).reset() and input_digest, returning ok/recomputed/mismatch findings; verify_claim_refs(verify_episodes=True) rejects a mismatched header; intact runs verify, wrong seed/episode and missing seed/header are named.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive header field and opt-in verifier/claim flag; dependency: worlds.grid + identity; concurrency: read-only; state: header schema additive, episode digest unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default seed=None and verify_episodes=False for backward compatibility; validate the header fields; test intact/wrong-seed/wrong-episode/missing-seed/missing-header/malformed and the claim-ref integration; rerun 402 tests plus AIKit.
